name: month_successor
description: Name the month k (1-4) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same arrow format with integer successor.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    k=random.randint(1,4)
    ex=random.sample(range(12),3)
    p=f"Count forward {k} month{'s' if k>1 else ''}.\n"+"".join(f"{M[e]} -> {M[(e+k)%12]}\n" for e in ex[:2])+f"{M[ex[2]]} ->"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+M[(ex[2]+k)%12]})
    ns=random.sample(range(1,60),3)
    c=f"Count forward {k}.\n"+"".join(f"{x} -> {x+k}\n" for x in ns[:2])+f"{ns[2]} ->"
    control.append({"prompt":c,"answer":f" {ns[2]+k}"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
